title: Pure Shining Sarcophagus
summary: Pure Shining Sarcophagus control build uniting Yugi Muto's iconic remake monsters under the continuous guidance of Shining Sarcophagus and generic staples. Each monster in the deck gains powerful disruption, protection, or self-summoning abilities while the golden chest remains on the field.

summary.title: Starters
points: Shining Sarcophagus is a Continuous Spell that searches any card mentioning Shining Sarcophagus from your Deck once per turn, and sends any opponent monster Special Summoned from the GY back to the GY.
Dark Magician Girl the Magician's Apprentice discards 1 card to Special Summon itself from the hand, then searches Shining Sarcophagus directly from your Deck.
Gadget Trio searches Shining Sarcophagus or a Spell or Trap mentioning it on Normal or Special Summon, and Sets Stronghold the Hidden Fortress from the Deck if destroyed.

Future Silence is a Quick-Play Spell that searches a monster mentioning Shining Sarcophagus from your Deck, and lets both players draw until they hold 6 cards if activated during the Battle Phase while you control Shining Sarcophagus.

summary.title: Opening: Gadget Trio + Any Monster
steps: Normal Summon Gadget Trio and activate its effect to search Shining Sarcophagus from your Deck.
Activate Shining Sarcophagus, and use its ignition effect to search Silent Magician Zero or Silent Swordsman Zero.
Activate Ties That Bind to Special Summon two Level 4 or lower monsters mentioning Shining Sarcophagus with different names from your Deck.
Field Silent Magician Zero to establish Spell negation and Silent Swordsman Zero to provide targeting protection for your board.
Set Turn Silence or Stronghold the Hidden Fortress to disrupt the opponent during their turn.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Silent Magician Zero negates the activation of an opponent's Spell Card or effect once per turn while Shining Sarcophagus is face-up, and gains 500 ATK whenever the opponent draws a card.
Silent Swordsman Zero negates an opponent's card or effect that targets Shining Sarcophagus or a monster mentioning it, and gains 500 ATK during each Standby Phase.

Gandora-G the Dragon of Destruction summons itself from the hand while Shining Sarcophagus is out, pays half your LP to destroy and banish all other cards on the field, and Special Summons a Level 7 or lower monster mentioning Shining Sarcophagus from the Deck.
Dark Magician the Magician of Black Magic Special Summons itself from the hand while Shining Sarcophagus is on the field, and recycles itself from the GY when destroyed.
Moremarshmallon forces all opponent attacks onto itself, Special Summons itself from the hand during the opponent's turn, and summons another copy from hand or Deck when destroyed.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Turn Silence Quick-Play Spell targets a face-up monster mentioning Shining Sarcophagus, increases its Level by 3, and negates the activation of an opponent's monster effect; it banishes from the GY in the Battle Phase to end the Battle Phase.
Stronghold the Hidden Fortress summons itself as a Trap Monster with 2000 DEF that gains 1000 ATK for each card mentioning Shining Sarcophagus you control, and destroys an attacking opponent monster.

Dark Magic Mirror Force destroys all Attack Position monsters your opponent controls when an attack is declared while you control Shining Sarcophagus and a monster mentioning it, preventing your monsters from being destroyed.
Ties That Bind summons two Level 4 or lower monsters mentioning Shining Sarcophagus directly from your hand or Deck.
